selected_categories.reasoning: The player is constrained to exactly three lanes and the primary action is lane switching to avoid hazards, which is the clearest mechanical match.
The game is an endless survival score chase with increasing speed and no level endpoint, matching endless runner structure.
The presentation strongly uses neon rails, synthwave-like glow, and a futuristic night palette, giving the runner a clear neon identity.
The obstacle set and fiction are train/rail themed, with incoming trains on track lanes shaping both visuals and gameplay reading.
Speed ramps up over time and reflex timing becomes the main challenge, though this is less exact than the lane and endless runner labels.

uncertainty_notes: The code mixes car-like variable naming with train-track presentation, so the fiction is slightly hybridized.
The game is not a typical forward-scrolling character runner; it is better described as a lane-dodge survival runner on rails.
Categories such as Obby runner, Sonic style runner, or Racing game are weaker matches because there is no jumping, free steering, or race completion structure.
